'''Czerka 431''' was a secret military research facility on the fringes of known [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that was run by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] took direct control of it and it and forced the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Joni Ree]] to perform experiments on [[Juggernaut war droid]]s. She disliked her employers and secretly contacted the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], giving them the location of the facility. She coordinated an escape attempt with the [[Battle of Czerka 431|Republic attack]] on Czerka 431.
